message: OK
cause: The request succeeded.
solution: Read the response body. Also check the x-health-app-privacy header.

message: Deleted successfully.
cause: A delete request succeeded. There is no response body.
solution: Treat as success. Do not try to parse a body.

message: Incorrect parameter.
cause: A query parameter or body field has a wrong type, format or value, for example a time range that is too long, a bad timestamp length, a wrong date format or an unknown data type name.
solution: Check the result code in the response and fix the request. Check time units (ms vs ns), the 30 or 31 day limit, yyyyMMdd dates and the +0800 time zone format.

message: 400 Bad Request invalidArgument
cause: The request parameters are incorrect even though the app configuration is correct.
solution: Check that URL parameters meet the parameter rules and that body fields have the right format and type.

message: Authentication failed.
cause: The access token in the Authorization header is missing, invalid or expired.
solution: Check the Authorization header (Bearer, a space, then the token). Refresh the access token with the refresh token and retry once.

message: Invalid Credentials
cause: The API was called with an invalid token, for example a token not obtained through OAuth 2.0, a token from a wrong flow, or an expired token.
solution: Get the token with the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow, follow the standard steps, and refresh it when it has expired.

message: Request rejected.
cause: The token does not have the scopes needed for this data, so the request is rejected.
solution: Apply for the scope on the Health Service Kit card, request it in the authorize URL, and make sure the user granted it. Check granted scopes with the token info API.

message: 403: Insufficient Permission: Request had insufficient authentication scopes.
cause: Scopes were not applied for on the Health Service Kit card, the appId used for the authorization code differs from the one that applied for scopes, or the user did not select the scopes.
solution: Apply for the scopes for the same appId, use that appId when requesting the code, and check the scope field returned by the token info API. Ask the user to authorize again if a scope is missing.

message: 403: The query time is out of range.
cause: The query asks for data from before the user authorized the app, and the app has no historical data scope that covers that time.
solution: Only query data after the authorization time, or request historydata.open.week, historydata.open.month or historydata.open.year. If a newly granted history scope does not work, cancel authorization and authorize again.

message: Request rejected (region not supported).
cause: The country or region of the user is not supported by Health Service Kit.
solution: Tell the user the service is not available in their region. Nothing to fix in the request.

message: Request rejected (more than 100 beta users).
cause: The app is still in beta (not verified) and already has more than 100 beta users.
solution: Apply for verification of the app on the Health Service Kit card so it can serve more users.

message: Request rejected (data not created by this app).
cause: The app tried to modify or delete data such as a DataCollector, ActivityRecord or custom data that another app created.
solution: Only modify or delete data that your app created.

message: Request rejected (PackageName does not match ClientId).
cause: PackageName in the request is not empty and does not match the ClientId.
solution: Send the package name that is registered for the same App ID, or leave it empty.

message: Request rejected (data type not supported for data groups).
cause: Data grouping was requested for a data type that does not support it.
solution: Use a data type that supports statistics, or query details and group them in the app.

message: Request rejected (DataCollector does not exist).
cause: The dataCollectorId in the request does not exist for this user.
solution: Check the dataCollectorId, or query by dataTypeName instead.

message: request forbidden due to site cross
cause: The request was sent to the wrong regional site, for example a user registered in Europe asking the China site. The response has a Location header with the correct domain.
solution: Read the Location header (for example https://health-api.cloud.huawei.eu/...) and send the same request again to that domain. Remember the domain for this user.

message: Application package name (xxx) provided by un-trusted source.
cause: The app package name used when creating data is not registered on HUAWEI Developers. HTTP status not stated on the page.
solution: Register the package name on HUAWEI Developers and wait for approval.

message: Service not found.
cause: The request URI is wrong, for example a typo in the path or the method suffix such as :dailyPolymerize.
solution: Check the request URI against the API page.

message: Invalid HTTP method.
cause: The HTTP method does not match the API, for example GET instead of POST.
solution: Use the method stated on the API page.

message: The data already exists.
cause: The data being created already exists.
solution: Check whether the data exists before creating it, or update it instead.

message: Internal service error.
cause: An error inside the Health Kit server.
solution: Retry later. If it keeps failing, submit a ticket at Support > Customer Service > Submit ticket online.

message: Gateway error.
cause: A gateway error between the client and the Health Kit server.
solution: Retry later with backoff.

message: Server unreachable.
cause: An internal error made the service unavailable.
solution: Retry later. If it keeps failing, submit a ticket at Support > Customer Service > Submit ticket online.

message: Abnormal CSE microservice.
cause: Usually the request body could not be parsed as JSON, or another internal CSE error happened.
solution: Check that the body is valid JSON with Content-Type application/json, then retry.

message: error=access_denied
cause: The user canceled authorization on the authorize page. The redirect URI is called with error=access_denied.
solution: Show the user that access was not granted and let them try again.

message: Success.
cause: The connection layer call succeeded.
solution: Check NSP_STATUS and the body for errors.

message: Authentication required.
cause: The connection layer requires authentication.
solution: Check the token or credentials sent.

message: Exception in the OpenGW.
cause: An error inside the open gateway.
solution: Retry later.

message: Other network errors.
cause: A network error (HTTP 502 to 504) between the client and the server.
solution: Retry later with backoff.

message: Success.
cause: The platform layer call succeeded.
solution: Check the return values for service errors.

message: Unknown error.
cause: An unknown platform error happened.
solution: Retry later. Contact Huawei support if it continues.

message: Services are unavailable for now.
cause: The service is temporarily unavailable.
solution: Retry later.

message: Unknown method.
cause: The called method does not exist.
solution: Check the nsp_svc or API name.

message: The number of requests to the app has reached the maximum.
cause: The app hit its request quota.
solution: Reduce calls and retry later.

message: Requests from unauthorized IP addresses.
cause: The calling IP address is not allowed.
solution: Call from an allowed IP address or check the IP settings.

message: The session key of the current user has expired.
cause: The access token or session key has expired.
solution: Get a new access token and retry.

message: The number of calls exceeded the maximum.
cause: The call quota was exceeded.
solution: Reduce calls and retry later.

message: API calls too frequent.
cause: Calls were made too often.
solution: Slow down and add backoff.

message: Unknown invalid parameter.
cause: A parameter is invalid.
solution: Check all request parameters.

message: Invalid API_KEY.
cause: The API key is invalid.
solution: Check the app credentials.

message: Invalid SESSION_KEY.
cause: The access token is invalid, for example wrong format or blocklisted after a password change.
solution: Get a new access token. If refresh fails, ask the user to sign in again.

message: The request must be submitted using the POST method.
cause: A GET or other method was used where POST is required.
solution: Send the request with POST.

message: Invalid signature.
cause: The request signature is wrong.
solution: Check how the signature is built.

message: System parameters such as nsp_svc, nsp_ts, and nsp_key are missing.
cause: Required system parameters are missing.
solution: Add the missing system parameters.

message: The app or session does not have the permission to call the current service.
cause: The app or session has no permission for this service.
solution: Check that the service is enabled for the app and the scopes are granted.

message: The values of client_id and client_secret need to be re-obtained due to reasons such as algorithm upgrade.
cause: The client credentials must be refreshed on the platform side.
solution: Get the current client_id and client_secret from AppGallery Connect.

message: The routing fails, and the request destination address cannot be identified.
cause: The request could not be routed.
solution: Check the URL and service name.

message: The nsp_ts value difference goes beyond the allowed range.
cause: The timestamp in the request is too far from server time.
solution: Sync the device or server clock and retry.

message: Internal API exception.
cause: An internal API error happened.
solution: Retry later.

message: No permission.
cause: The caller has no permission.
solution: Check app permissions and scopes.

message: Failed to call the API.
cause: The Account Kit API call failed.
solution: Fix the problem based on the error description.

message: The client_id and client_secret fields do not match. (Account Kit page: The client_secret parameter has an incorrect value.)
cause: The client_secret sent to the token endpoint is wrong for this client_id.
solution: Use the App Secret of the same App ID from AppGallery Connect.

message: The format of client_id is incorrect. It must contain digits only.
cause: client_id has non digit characters.
solution: Send the numeric App ID as client_id.

message: The client_id parameter does not exist in the system.
cause: The App ID is unknown to the account server.
solution: Check the App ID in AppGallery Connect.

message: The format of response_type is incorrect. It has a fixed value of code.
cause: response_type is not code on the authorize URL.
solution: Set response_type=code.

message: The format of redirect_uri is incorrect.
cause: redirect_uri is malformed or not URL encoded.
solution: Send a valid, URL encoded redirect_uri.

message: The value of redirect_uri is different from the redirection URL specified in AppGallery Connect and is not trustlisted in the app's OAuth settings.
cause: redirect_uri is not registered for the app.
solution: Add the exact redirect URL in AppGallery Connect OAuth settings, or use the registered one.

message: The value of redirect_uri parsed from the authorization code is different from that passed as an input parameter in the request for using the authorization code to obtain an access token.
cause: The token request uses a different redirect_uri than the authorize request.
solution: Send exactly the same redirect_uri in the token request as in the authorize request.

message: The format of state is incorrect.
cause: The state parameter is malformed.
solution: Send a simple URL safe random string as state.

message: The format of scope is incorrect.
cause: The scope list is malformed, for example wrong separators or encoding.
solution: Join scopes with spaces (URL encoded) and use full scope URLs.

message: The scope parameter does not exist in the system.
cause: One requested scope is not a known scope.
solution: Check each scope string, for example https://www.huawei.com/healthkit/step.read.

message: The format of access_type is incorrect.
cause: access_type has an invalid value.
solution: Use access_type=offline to get a refresh token.

message: The format of display is incorrect. (The value is page for PCs, and touch for mobile devices.)
cause: display has an invalid value.
solution: Use display=touch on phones or page on PCs.

message: Invalid code_challenge_method. Currently, only S256 and plain are supported.
cause: PKCE method is not S256 or plain.
solution: Use code_challenge_method=S256.

message: Invalid code_challenge, which cannot be decoded by Base64.
cause: The PKCE code_challenge is not valid Base64.
solution: Build code_challenge as Base64 URL encoded SHA-256 of code_verifier.

message: Invalid need_code parameter.
cause: The need_code parameter has an invalid value.
solution: Fix or remove need_code.

message: The authorization code used to obtain an access token has an incorrect format.
cause: The code was cut, changed or double encoded before the token request.
solution: Send the code exactly as received in the redirect, URL encoded once in the form body.

message: The value of client_id in an authorization code, a device code, or a refresh token is different from that of the input parameter.
cause: The code or refresh token was issued to another App ID.
solution: Use the same App ID that started the authorization.

message: The authorization code used to obtain an access token has expired. The default validity period is 5 minutes.
cause: The code was exchanged more than 5 minutes after it was issued.
solution: Exchange the code right away. Ask the user to authorize again to get a new code.

message: The authorization code used to obtain an access token has been used once. It cannot be used for such a request anymore.
cause: The same code was sent to the token endpoint twice, for example a retry or double tap.
solution: Use each code only once. Make the exchange idempotent and start a new authorization if needed.

message: The format of code_verifier is incorrect.
cause: The PKCE code_verifier is malformed.
solution: Use a 43 to 128 character code_verifier with allowed characters.

message: code_verifier and code_challenge do not match.
cause: The code_verifier does not match the code_challenge sent on the authorize request.
solution: Send the same code_verifier that produced the code_challenge.

message: The format of client_secret in the request for obtaining an access token is incorrect.
cause: client_secret is malformed.
solution: Send the App Secret as is, URL encoded.

message: Invalid client_secret.
cause: client_secret is wrong.
solution: Use the current App Secret from AppGallery Connect.

message: The value of grant_type in the request for obtaining an access token is invalid. Its value must be authorization_code, client_credentials, refresh_token, or device_code.
cause: grant_type has an invalid value.
solution: Use grant_type=authorization_code or refresh_token.

message: The refresh token used to obtain an access token has an incorrect format.
cause: The stored refresh token was changed, cut or double encoded.
solution: Store and send the refresh token exactly as received, URL encoded once.

message: The format of user code is incorrect.
cause: Device code flow: user code is malformed.
solution: Not used by the authorization code flow. Check the device flow user code.

message: The user code parameter has expired or is invalid.
cause: Device code flow: user code expired or invalid.
solution: Start the device flow again.

message: The user code parameter has expired.
cause: Device code flow: user code expired.
solution: Start the device flow again.

message: The device code used to obtain an access token has been used once. It cannot be used for such a request anymore.
cause: Device code flow: device code reused.
solution: Start the device flow again.

message: After an access token is obtained through a device code, the system checks the access token status at a specified interval, but only finds it is not put into use within the allowed maximum duration. Then the access token will become invalid. You need to obtain a new access token.
cause: Device code flow: token not used in time.
solution: Get a new access token.

message: When a device code is used to obtain an access token, the value of scope parsed from the device code is invalid.
cause: Device code flow: invalid scope.
solution: Check the scopes used for the device flow.

message: The value of user code has been used when a barcode is scanned for authorization. The value can be used only once.
cause: Device code flow: user code reused.
solution: Start the device flow again.

message: The value of user code has been used to obtain an access token when a barcode is scanned for authorization. The value can be used only once.
cause: Device code flow: user code reused.
solution: Start the device flow again.

message: The QR code has expired but is still not scanned when a device code is used to obtain an access token.
cause: Device code flow: QR code expired before scan.
solution: Show a new QR code.

message: The user scans the QR code, the QR code has expired, but the authorization has not been performed when a device code is used to obtain an access token.
cause: Device code flow: QR code expired before the user approved.
solution: Show a new QR code.

message: If the value of redirect_uri does not start with hms, the redirection URL specified by the value is not that registered with AppGallery Connect.
cause: redirect_uri is not the one registered in AppGallery Connect.
solution: Register the redirect URL in AppGallery Connect or use the registered one.

message: The client_id parameter is left empty.
cause: client_id is missing.
solution: Send client_id.

message: The response_type parameter is left empty.
cause: response_type is missing on the authorize URL.
solution: Send response_type=code.

message: The redirect_uri parameter is left empty.
cause: redirect_uri is missing.
solution: Send the registered redirect_uri.

message: The authorization code or device code is left empty in the request for obtaining an access token.
cause: code is missing in the token request.
solution: Send the code received in the redirect.

message: The client_secret parameter is left empty in the request for obtaining an access token.
cause: client_secret is missing.
solution: Send the App Secret from your server.

message: The grant_type parameter is left empty in the request for obtaining an access token.
cause: grant_type is missing.
solution: Send grant_type.

message: The refresh_token parameter is left empty in the request for obtaining an access token.
cause: refresh_token is missing in a refresh request.
solution: Send the stored refresh token. If none is stored, ask the user to authorize again.

message: The user code parameter is left empty.
cause: Device code flow: user code missing.
solution: Send the user code.

message: The authorization code used to obtain an access token failed to be parsed.
cause: The code is invalid or was changed.
solution: Send the code exactly as received. If it still fails, authorize again.

message: The refresh token used to obtain an access token has expired.
cause: The refresh token is past its validity (about 6 months, 180 days by default) or was invalidated by a password change, account freeze, deletion, sign out or similar.
solution: Mark the refresh token as expired, clear it, and ask the user to sign in and authorize again.

message: The value of client_id in the request for using the authorization code to obtain an access token does not exist.
cause: client_id is unknown.
solution: Check the App ID.

message: The value of client_secret in the request for using the authorization code to obtain an access token is incorrect.
cause: client_secret is wrong.
solution: Use the App Secret of the same App ID.

message: The refresh token used to obtain an access token meets the regular expression but fails to be parsed.
cause: The refresh token was cut or transcoded, for example stored with a length limit or double encoded.
solution: Store the full token as received. Ask the user to authorize again if it is broken.

message: The refresh token used to obtain an access token is blocklisted. If a user changes the password or signs out, the refresh token will be blocklisted.
cause: The user changed the password or signed out, so the refresh token was blocklisted.
solution: Mark the refresh token as expired and ask the user to sign in and authorize again.

message: The refresh token used to obtain an access token does not meet the regular expression.
cause: The value sent is not a valid refresh token, for example an access token or a damaged value.
solution: Send the stored refresh token unchanged.

message: The device code cannot be encoded. (This error is reported by the server and does not occur when the server is properly configured.)
cause: Device code flow: server side encoding error.
solution: Retry later.

message: The device code cannot be parsed when it is used to obtain an access token.
cause: Device code flow: device code invalid.
solution: Start the device flow again.

message: The device code has expired when it is used to obtain an access token.
cause: Device code flow: device code expired.
solution: Start the device flow again.

message: Other errors, such as network disconnection between internal components.
cause: An internal error in the account server.
solution: Retry later. If it continues, contact Huawei support.

message: HEALTHKIT_ACCOUNT_AUTH_FAIL: Account authorization failed.
cause: The account authorization step failed, usually because of wrong configuration.
solution: Check the App ID, package name, signing certificate fingerprint and scopes in the console.

message: HEALTHKIT_SDK_TO_APP_FAIL: The Huawei Health app failed to launch.
cause: The SDK could not open the Huawei Health app, for example it is not installed, too old, or Android 11 package visibility blocks it.
solution: Check the parameters, make sure Huawei Health is installed and updated, and add the queries element for com.huawei.health.action.KIT_SERVICE.

message: HEALTHKIT_SDK_TO_H5_FAIL: HTML5 authorization failed.
cause: The fallback HTML5 authorization page failed.
solution: Check the parameters passed to the SDK.

message: HEALTHKIT_DEEPLINK_THIRDSERVICE_FAIL: Failed to redirect to the deep link.
cause: The deep link back to your app failed, for example the scheme URL does not match the AndroidManifest intent filter.
solution: Check that the scheme URL is correct and matches the manifest.

message: APP_MCP_CHECK_FAIL: MCP verification failed.
cause: The client ID check failed.
solution: Check that the client ID (App ID) is correct.

message: APP_SIGNATURE_OR_DEEPLINKURL_AUTH_FAIL: Verification of the third-party app signature or callback URL failed.
cause: The app signing certificate fingerprint or the callback URL does not match the console settings.
solution: Check the app signature (SHA-256 fingerprint) and the callback URL registered for the app.

message: APP_SCOPES_CHECK_FAIL: The valid scope list returned by the cloud is empty.
cause: None of the requested scopes is approved for the app.
solution: Check the scope list and that the scopes are approved on the Health Service Kit card.

message: APP_CANCEL_AUTH_OR_AUTH_FAIL: Third-party authorization failed, indicating a failure to obtain code or the cancellation of authorization.
cause: The user canceled, or the code could not be obtained.
solution: Check whether the user canceled and whether the parameters are correct. Let the user try again.

message: APP_ANY_PARMA_EMPTY: Parameter missing.
cause: A required parameter passed to the SDK is empty.
solution: Check that no parameter is empty.

message: H5_CANCEL_AUTH: The user cancels authorization.
cause: The user canceled on the HTML5 authorization page.
solution: Show that access was not granted and let the user try again.

message: H5_APPID_OR_SCOPES_WRONG: The parameter appID or scopes is incorrect.
cause: appID or a scope string is wrong.
solution: Check appID and the scope strings.

message: H5_APPID_OR_SCOPES_EMPTY: The parameter appID or scopes is empty.
cause: appID or scopes is empty.
solution: Pass appID and a non empty scope list.

message: HMS_CANCEL_AUTH: Authorization canceled.
cause: The user canceled authorization in HMS Core.
solution: Show that access was not granted and let the user try again.

message: HMS_SCOPE_LIST_EMPTY: No scope is configured for OpenGW.
cause: No scope is configured for the app on the gateway.
solution: Check the scope configuration for the app in the console.

message: HMS_APPID_WRONG: Incorrect parameter.
cause: The App ID configuration is wrong.
solution: Check the configuration, for example the appID in the AndroidManifest file (agconnect or meta-data).

message: DEEPLINK_RESULT 0: deeplink success
cause: Returned in onActivityResult data when the deep link back to the app worked.
solution: Read the code from the deep link query parameters.

message: DEEPLINK_RESULT non zero with DEEPLINK_MSG: deeplink fail
cause: deepLinkUrl is wrong or does not match the manifest, so the result could not be delivered by deep link. The value is a LoginFreeSDKStatusCodes value.
solution: Read DEEPLINK_RESULT and DEEPLINK_MSG in onActivityResult, map the value with LoginFreeSDKStatusCodes, and fix the deep link.

message: errorCode query parameter on the deep link
cause: Authorization failed and the result came back on the deep link with an errorCode parameter instead of code.
solution: Read errorCode and map it with LoginFreeSDKStatusCodes.

message: FAILED returned by the SDK on Android 11 or later
cause: With targetSdkVersion 30 or higher the app cannot see the Huawei Health app because of package visibility rules.
solution: Add a queries element with action com.huawei.health.action.KIT_SERVICE to AndroidManifest.xml, or update the SDK to 6.7.0.300 or later.

message: 204 No Content (callback test or notification accepted)
cause: Your callback returned 204, so the connectivity test passed or the notification was accepted.
solution: Return 204 quickly from /healthkit/notifications after signature verification. Fetch the data asynchronously.

message: 404 (callback connectivity test failed or signature verification failed)
cause: The callback did not return 204, or signature verification of the notification failed.
solution: Use an HTTPS URL that ends with /healthkit/notifications in lowercase, verify x-notification-signature, return 204, and run Test Connectivity on the Health Service Kit card.

message: 400, Bad Request, or Failed to connect to the URL when creating a subscription record
cause: The subscription callback URL is not reachable or does not return 204.
solution: Sign in to HUAWEI Developers, open the Health Service Kit card, click Manage then Test Connectivity. Create the subscription after the test succeeds.

message: Scope check failed for the subscribed event type
cause: Adding a subscription checks scopes: ACTIVITY_RECORD_EVENT needs the activityRecord or activity read scope, SAMPLESET_EVENT$UPDATE${dataType} needs the read scope of that data type. The exact status code is not stated on the page; 403 is the REST code for insufficient scopes.
solution: Only subscribe to events whose read scope the user granted.

message: No notification received in HTTP subscription mode
cause: The subscription capability is not registered, the callback is not reachable, no subscription record exists, the record was created by another App ID, the user signed in to Huawei Health with another account, or no new data was generated.
solution: Register the subscription capability (enterprise account only), test connectivity, query subscription records, check App ID and account, and generate new data in Huawei Health.

message: Subscription records deleted after subscriber deregistration
cause: After subscriber information is deregistered, previously generated subscription records are deleted.
solution: Create new subscription records when the user authorizes the app again.

message: Subscription APIs use the REST Result Codes
cause: POST/GET/DELETE /healthkit/v2/subscriptions and achievedRecord return the same HTTP result codes as other REST APIs (see REST entries).
solution: Handle them like the REST domain entries.

message: The user has granted authorization in the Huawei Health app.
cause: The Huawei Health switch that opens data to Health Kit is on.
solution: Use the returned data normally.

message: The user has not granted authorization in the Huawei Health app.
cause: The user has Huawei Health but did not turn on data sharing to Health Kit, so data from Huawei Health and wearables is not returned (responses are empty).
solution: Ask the user to open Huawei Health, Me > Privacy management, and turn on HUAWEI Health Kit (iPhone: Me > Third party services > HUAWEI Health Kit > LINK), or show the HTML5 linking page.

message: The user is not a Huawei Health app user (authorization not required).
cause: The account has no Huawei Health app data, so no privacy switch applies.
solution: Explain that data comes only from Huawei Health and wearables. Expect empty results until the user uses Huawei Health.

message: privacyRecords opinion 1: The user has granted authorization in the Huawei Health app.
cause: Same meaning as x-health-app-privacy 1, returned by GET /healthkit/v2/profile/privacyRecords.
solution: Proceed to read data.

message: privacyRecords opinion 2: The user has not granted authorization in the Huawei Health app.
cause: Same meaning as x-health-app-privacy 2.
solution: Prompt the user to turn on HUAWEI Health Kit in Huawei Health privacy management.

message: privacyRecords opinion 3: The user is not a Huawei Health app user (authorization cannot be granted).
cause: Same meaning as x-health-app-privacy 3.
solution: Tell the user Huawei Health is needed for wearable data.

message: HTML5 linking page resultCode 0: Huawei Health app authorized to open data to Health Service Kit.
cause: The user tapped LINK on the Health Kit linking page and it succeeded.
solution: Close the WebView and read data.

message: HTML5 linking page resultCode 401: Huawei Health app fails to be authorized to open data to Health Service Kit.
cause: Linking on the HTML5 page failed or was not completed.
solution: Let the user try again, or guide them to the switch in Huawei Health.
